title: The Ledger of the Lower Danube
author: Marguerite Ishikawa
blurb: Wendell Oyelaran, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
